text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Surface degraded sweep records in the check run**

When a pass reaches review execution and completes with an unrecognized enablement value or an invalid category list, these steps only log the corresponding record. The spec assigns both `sweep-did-not-run` and the unrecognized-enablement record to the same surfaces as the per-category record, so a successful review-outcome check run must carry them as well; however, the planned `CheckRunOutputInput` only accepts `SweepPassRecord`. Add degraded-state fields/rendering and tests for their presence in successful check-run output while keeping them out of the review body.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
